answer: A single-file velvet booth blocks minted identities. The applicant locks 2.08 POA against a 22-byte ticket, then over 16 hours files five 17-byte path stamps 67 minutes apart, each from a new /21. At a ridge gate two clerks issue an echo query; the applicant has 11 seconds to return a nonce tied to the ticket and current tip. A reused /18, stamps under 50 minutes, or a 9-byte ticket prefix already seen that day is void. Three booths of the same wallet inside 12 hours burn the tickets and hold the 2.08 POA for 6 epochs. Missed stamp or late echo ends the booth; no spare ticket is issued.
